Meta.title: Panda's Elonaplus Blood Rod Effect Mod
Meta.author: Now Happy Panda
Meta.description: Add a spcecial function to Blood Rod from Elona+ Oddities mod Attacking with it now consumes 5% of your maximum MP if you are above 20MP, and adds 0.5% of your max MP to your attack dice (up to 200; to reach that, one must have 40,000 mana for maximum effect, and then each attack will drain 2000)
